title: Create a new Project
answer: Go to Planning → Projects, select New Project, complete the required project information, choose the relevant Business Unit/Portfolio/Owner where applicable, then select Save.

title: Performance & KPI
answer: Go to Performance & KPI. Use the relevant period and employee/project scope, then add or import KPI/Performance data using the actions available on that screen.

title: Annual Work & Budget Plan
answer: Go to Planning → Annual Work & Budget Plan. Select the required year, then use New or Import depending on how you want to enter the plan.

title: Create Contract
answer: Go to Financial Control → Contracts, select New Contract, choose an active Project and Supplier, complete the required contract information, then select Save Contract.

title: Create Supplier
answer: Go to Supplier Management, select Add Supplier, enter Supplier Name, Company/Legal Name, Tax Code, Website, Contact Person, Email, Phone, Address and other profile information as needed, then select Add Supplier.

title: IT Assets & Services
answer: Go to ORGANIZATION → IT Assets & Services to manage laptops, desktops, servers, network equipment and other IT resources. Record Business Unit, assignment and lifecycle details. Visibility follows the user's permitted Business Unit/Data Scope.

title: IT Licenses
answer: In ORGANIZATION → IT Assets & Services, open Licenses. Add product/license details, Business Unit, assigned user or installed device where applicable, supplier/contract and validity dates, then Save.

title: Domain Management
answer: In ORGANIZATION → IT Assets & Services, open Domains. Enter Domain Name, type, Business Unit, manager, registrar, supplier/contract if applicable, registration/expiry and renewal information, then Save.

title: Functional Permissions and Data Scope
answer: Functional Permissions control what actions and modules a user can use. Data Scope controls which Projects, Business Units and domain data the user can see. A user may have multiple Business Units and Projects. If a function is visible but data is missing, check Data Scope; if the function is unavailable, check Functional Permissions.

title: Delete / Deactivate
answer: Deleted items may be stored as Deactivated for audit purposes. Deactivated items are treated as deleted and should not appear in normal lists or dropdown selections.

title: Projects
answer: Go to PLANNING → Projects. Create or edit the project, select its Portfolio and Business Unit information, complete the project details and Save. A project may be associated with multiple Business Units where configured.

title: Budget Control and Import
answer: Go to FINANCIAL CONTROL → Budget Control. Use Import to load the Excel template or Export to download data/template. Imported rows must use project and Business Unit information permitted by your Data Scope. MPMS shows processing status during import.

title: Contracts
answer: Go to FINANCIAL CONTROL → Contracts. Add the contract, select the related project and supplier where applicable, enter values, dates and required information, attach supporting documents when available, then Save.

title: Suppliers
answer: Go to FINANCIAL CONTROL → Suppliers to create and maintain supplier records. Supplier information is reused by Contracts and relevant IT Asset/Service records.

title: Performance & KPI
answer: Go to PERFORMANCE → Performance & KPI. Review or enter KPI information for the permitted period and scope. Personal/OWN KPI is visible to its owner where applicable; broader team data depends on Functional Permissions and Data Scope.

title: IT Asset Assignment and Handover
answer: In IT Assets & Services, select the asset and use assignment/handover to record the recipient and handover information. Attach the handover document where available. Record returns so the asset can be stored and reassigned while preserving history.

title: Personal FC
answer: Go to FINANCIAL CONTROL → Personal FC to create, review and maintain Personal FC records available to your account and permitted scope.

title: Import and Export
answer: Use Import or Export in the relevant module. Import shows a processing indicator while the file is handled. If you have Export permission but there is no data in your permitted scope, Export should still provide a valid empty Excel template where the module supports import/export.

title: Documents and Attachments
answer: Use the document or attachment controls in the relevant MPMS record. Files may be stored through the configured Microsoft 365/SharePoint document storage. Use Preview/Open where supported.

title: Club Management
answer: Use enabled Club functions to maintain Club Members and profile information, organize Tournaments, Teams and Matches, and review Standings and related club information.
